title: LLM-Powered AI Tutors with Personas for d/Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing Online Learners

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative user study where d/Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing (DHH) participants interacted with LLM-powered AI tutors assigned different personas to evaluate the models' accessibility accommodations, communication styles (e.g., lack of sign language multimodality), and representation of DHH needs.

Thematic analysis of participant interactions and interviews to assess the AI models' cultural knowledge, authenticity of persona positioning within the DHH community, and awareness of historical DHH social constructs.
